answer: Random peer audit stops a dune of hollow identities. Each epoch the network draws 5% of identities and hands each to three auditors, who verify its work and stamp an onyx seal. Every identity posts a 200 POA bond. An attacker with 100 hollow identities locks 100 x 200 = 20,000 POA; a failed audit burns the bond and revokes the identity, so the farm loses 20,000. Auditors earn burned bonds. An honest agent pays one bond once, keeps its earnings.
